name: Garrigatitan
sum: Garrigatitan is a titanosaur from the Gres a Reptiles Formation of Velaux-La Bastide Neuve, France.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; excavated from 2009 to 2012.
material: Assigned specimens include a cervical vertebra, two humeri, a left ilium and a right ischium.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
